title: MZ Right-to-left or Arabic windows and text animation

posts.author: Nayef
posts.body:
Hello,
I'm just starting out with RMMZ and trying to make an Arabic language game. I tried to look for advice online (and AI had a couple of pieces of advice too) for flipping my boxes to be right-to-left.
Since I'm at the very genning I haven't gone too far just yet but here's my Options window from the title page:
I'd like to figure out how to flip it so that OFF/ON/100%/etc are on the left side and put the Arabic text on the right.
Google's AI gave me the following:
Option 1: Use the VisuStella MZ Core Engine
If you are already using VisuStella plugins, this is the easiest method. The Core Engine plugin has a built-in feature to change the menu layout without writing any code.
Open your project in RPG Maker MZ.
Go to the
Plugin Manager
(Tools > Plugin Manager).
Double-click the VisuMZ_0_CoreEngine plugin to open its parameters.
Find the "Menu Layout Settings" parameter and expand it.
Locate the entry for Scene_Menu and adjust the position parameters for the command window and other windows to place them on the right side of the screen.
Click to expand...
I got that plugin but I didn't know how to change the parameters to make it work, especially for a title menu like the above.
It also gave me another option to make a custom .js to change windows RTL and I implemented it but it didn't seem to apply to a menu title item.
Option 2: Use custom JavaScript as a plugin
You can create a small, dedicated plugin with a single block of JavaScript code to override the default menu behavior.
In your project's js/plugins folder, create a new file and name it something like RightToLeftMenu.js.
Open the file in a text editor (like Notepad++ or VS Code) and add the following code:
javascript
/*:
* @target MZ
* @plugindesc Changes menu layout for right-to-left input mode.
* @author YourName
* @help Free to use and/or modify for any project.
*/
(function() {
Scene_MenuBase.prototype.isRightInputMode = function() {
return true;
};
})();
Save and close the file.
In RPG Maker MZ, open the
Plugin Manager
and add your new RightToLeftMenu.js plugin to your project.
Save your project and run a playtest. The change should be applied to the pause menu, status screens, and other default menus.
Click to expand...
Does anyone know to flip that title menu item in the pic above? And moreover are there any dedicated plugins or tips to support RTL animated text or text direction aside from what was mentioned above?
Thanks and feel free to move this to another subforum if this isn't the right place to post this thread.
